description: Copies one Notion page under a parent page or into a data source, by reading the source page and creating a new one; Notion's API has no duplicate. The copy carries the title, the content as markdown, the icon and cover when they are an emoji or a link, and, in a data source, the property values the target schema accepts. Comments, page history, page-level permissions, files stored in Notion, and blocks with no markdown form are not carried by a duplicate; content is copied as Notion's markdown rendering, so some block formatting can differ. Returns the new page's id and url, properties_not_copied with the reason for each, unknown_block_ids (blocks that could not be copied) and content_truncated.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

page_id.description: The page to copy's Notion id, with or without dashes, or a Notion URL that contains it (the id is read from the URL).

parent_data_source_id.description: The parent data source's Notion id (notion_get_database lists a database's data sources). The page becomes a row of it. Exactly one of parent_page_id and parent_data_source_id is set.

parent_page_id.description: The parent page's Notion id or URL. Exactly one of parent_page_id and parent_data_source_id is set.

title.description: The copy's title. Absent keeps the source page's title.

name: notion-mcp__notion_duplicate_page
